task_description: Diagnostics-first fix for the persistent 'No models available yet' with no error and no models on the user's built Windows app. Primary deliverable: make the app self-report what actually happens on the model-enumeration load path (a visible, copyable Settings 'Diagnostics' section + chat status line, fed by a new display-safe provider_diagnostics backend command). Secondary: fix the two invisible clean-empty causes traced in the load path - (backend) a configured provider row with no built instance is silently skipped in providers::list_available_models, and (frontend) the providers store load() swallows an IPC throw leaving models:[]/errors:[] with no signal - and stop a single un-buildable provider row from aborting the whole enumeration. Investigation + instrumentation, NOT another blind adapter tweak: do NOT change the Ollama IPv4 default or cloud-registration logic. Update the spec/README. Committed on branch feat/model-picker-diagnostics-selfreport; do NOT push/tag/PR.
